notes.title: SRX 1.0 - Out of early-access ! Urban episode, vehicle models and leaderboards
notes.notes:
[b][h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] We are out of early access. It means that we see the game as stable and with enough content to considere it a full game. But it does not mean that we won't add new content in the future...
[*] The store page now features a free demo
[*] A new episode based in City environment is now available. Only players that obtained a few medals on other episodes can access it.
[*] Some vehicles did not share the same graphic charts. There are now all low-poly and some default skins have been changed.
[*] Online leaderboards are now live.
[/list]

[b][h1]NEW[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] [Tracks] 6 new tracks are available in the new Urban episode
[*] [Tracks] 1 new track has been added to the Misc episode
[*] [Environment] The main scenario in City environment is now finished
[*] [UX] A new option to hide other players ghosts is available in the Gameplay tab
[/list]

[b][h1]CHANGES / IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] [Vehicles] The JetRanger helicopter is now low-poly
[*] [Vehicles] The secondary skin of the JetRanger has been replaced
[*] [Vehicles] The Patroller drone is now low-poly

[*] [Vehicles] The default BePop skin has been replaced

notes.title: Beta 3.3 - Time Trial highlight, UX / UI and performance
notes.notes:
[b][h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] All multiplayer modes have been deactivated until further notice. The main mode, Time Trial, now allows players to register their score without connecting to a server. The leaderboard of each track are highlighted and can be displayed in many areas.
[*] Due to working progress with the new leaderboard system, global ranking is disabled until the next update.
[*] Visualize top ranked of friend players simply and directly inside the game. To each leaderboard entry is linked the vehicle used by the player and the ghost of the player ahead of you will be displayed when racing.
[*] The main menu has been entirely redone, all menus and game modes are gathered and accessible from a single panel.
[*] UI elements have been reviewed in all screens, becoming more effective and homogeneous.
[/list]

[b][h1]NEW[/h1][/b]

[*] [UX] The ghost of the player ahead of you in the leaderboard is displayed during the race

notes.title: Steam Cloud Setup
notes.notes:
SRX now supports Steam Cloud and synchronize your records between your devices.

The [b]medal count[/b] and [b]your ghosts[/b] will also be saved, preventing you from restarting the Solo campaign on each device.

notes.title: Beta 3.0 - SRX redesign
notes.notes:
We finally went for a specific graphic style!

[previewyoutube=RussciJjjuM;full][/previewyoutube]
Therefore, ALL environments and tracks have been replaced.

New environments are centered on what we call "[i]scenarios[/i]".

Each scenario relates a story frozen in time, where the player can progress, in either fast-paced "[b]Time Trial[/b]" races, every scenario element becoming an obstacle, in the "[b]Exploration[/b]" mode where the player can hunt hidden treasures or in the contemplative mode "Free Play", without any goal or time limit...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559364/8bdf2126ac7ea761089caa6547bec85ae959bf1c.gif[/img]

In the solo campaign, tracks use the objects and characters of a scenario to plan their path. For a single scenario, you will find multiple tracks, travelling between the elements of this story frozen in time.

Tracks are grouped into episodes, each track having its own difficulty. We are launching this update with an initiation episode, two main ones and a Bonus episode containing test tracks targeting the most courageous players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559364/2756781e555896cdf186cc3e7f182e65d114800e.png[/img]

We have many plans, resources and themes for the future!

You may have noticed that the graphics not only changed but implied a new scale between the player and the environment. Vehicles are thus the size of big insects, turning a simple room into a wide playground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559364/2560cde7a03e8f02ba3a458bbc3f84d957d7d176.png[/img]

New scale means new behaviour and we then took this opportunity to rebalance all vehicles, now close together in performance. Following your feedback, each vehicle now has its own behaviour, suitable for some tracks but behind other vehicles on others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559364/afbadc5cfd72eaf72f23e74c79c01322d9362c64.png[/img]

Finally, we are gradually giving importance to the Exploration mode, enhancing the treasure hunt system. For the moment, we reworked the user interface, giving more info about what to seek and their spawning area.
We would like to quickly adding more fun and challenge to this mode by spawning objects only one player can grab for instance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37559364/0601c261f6ba30e30b5e25c25e964176e86c37fb.png[/img]

We hope you will like this major update, feel free to send us feedback and suggestions.

See you soon,
Arokma Studio.
